story.text: 핸드폰 진동 소리에 눈을 떴다. 평소라면 늦잠을 자고도 남았을 시간이었다.
story.reading: haen-deu-pon jin-dong so-ri-e nun-eul tteot-da. pyeong-so-ra-myeon neut-jam-eul ja-go-do nam-a-sseul si-gan-i-eot-da.
story.en: I woke up to my phone buzzing. It was an hour I'd normally still be oversleeping at.

story.text: 화면에는 '선우'라는 이름이 떠 있었다. 이렇게 일찍 전화할 사람이 아닌데, 하며 반쯤 감긴 눈으로 전화를 받았다.
story.reading: hwa-myeon-e-neun 'seon-u'-ra-neun i-reum-i tteo iss-eot-da. i-reo-ke il-jjik jeon-hwa-hal sa-ram-i a-nin-de, ha-myeo ban-jjeum gam-gin nun-eu-ro jeon-hwa-reul bad-at-da.
story.en: There was "Sunwoo" on the screen. He wasn't usually one to call this early, I thought, answering with my eyes still half shut.

story.text: "야, 니 아직도 자나? 해 중천에 떴다 아이가." 수화기 너머 목소리가 유난히 쨍쨍했다.
story.reading: "ya, ni a-jik-do ja-na? hae jung-cheon-e tteot-da a-i-ga." su-hwa-gi neo-meo mok-so-ri-ga yu-nan-hi jjaeng-jjaeng-haet-da.
story.en: "Hey, are you still sleeping? The sun's already high in the sky." His voice on the other end was unusually bright and sharp.

story.text: 이불 속에서 크게 기지개를 켜며 몸을 일으켰다. 삐걱거리는 관절 소리가 방 안에 울렸다.
story.reading: i-bul sok-e-seo keu-ge gi-ji-gae-reul kyeo-myeo mom-eul il-eu-kyeot-da. ppi-geok-geo-ri-neun gwan-jeol so-ri-ga bang an-e ul-lyeot-da.
story.en: I stretched big under the blanket and pushed myself up. My creaking joints echoed through the room.

story.text: 세수를 하고 나오니 정신이 한결 상쾌했다. 결국 못 이기는 척 옷을 챙겨 입고 밖으로 나섰다.
story.reading: se-su-reul ha-go na-o-ni jeong-sin-i han-gyeol sang-kwae-haet-da. gyeol-guk mot i-gi-neun cheok os-eul chaeng-gyeo ib-go bakk-eu-ro na-seot-da.
story.en: After washing my face, my mind felt much more refreshed. In the end, pretending I had no choice, I got dressed and headed outside.

story.text: 골목 어귀에 선우가 팔짱을 끼고 서 있었다. 나를 보자마자 씩 웃으며 손을 흔들었다.
story.reading: gol-mok eo-gwi-e seon-u-ga pal-jjang-eul kki-go seo iss-eot-da. na-reul bo-ja-ma-ja ssik us-eu-myeo son-eul heun-deul-eot-da.
story.en: Sunwoo was standing at the alley entrance with his arms crossed. The moment he saw me, he grinned and waved.

story.text: "봐라, 나왔네. 좋은 아침이다, 가시나야." 그의 활기찬 목소리에 나도 모르게 잠이 마저 달아났다.
story.reading: "bwa-ra, na-wat-ne. jo-eun a-chim-i-da, ga-si-na-ya." geu-ui hwal-gi-chan mok-so-ri-e na-do mo-reu-ge jam-i ma-jeo dal-a-nat-da.
story.en: "See, you came out. Good morning, kid." His energetic voice chased away the last of my sleepiness before I even noticed.

story.text: "오늘 아침 인사말부터 하나씩 익혀보자. 단어랑 대화 문제까지, 끝까지 함께 가보자고."
story.reading: "o-neul a-chim in-sa-mal-bu-teo ha-na-ssik ik-yeo-bo-ja. dan-eo-rang dae-hwa mun-je-kka-ji, kkeut-kka-ji ham-kke ga-bo-ja-go."
story.en: "Let's learn today's morning greetings one by one. Words and the conversation questions too — let's go through it all together."

words.example_en: Today I woke up earlier than usual.
Stretching every morning loosens up my body.
Washing my face with cold water, I felt refreshed.
Sleeping in on weekends is my one joy.
He always greets people with an energetic voice.

sentences.en: I woke up early today and started my day.
Stretching in the morning wakes you up.
A refreshing breeze brushed past my face.
I overslept and almost was late for the appointment.
He greeted me energetically in the morning.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 야, 니 아직도 자나? 해 중천에 떴다 아이가.
turns.reading: ya, ni a-jik-do ja-na? hae jung-cheon-e tteot-da a-i-ga.
turns.en: Hey, are you still asleep? The sun's already high up in the sky.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: …몇 신데 벌써 전화고. 나 방금 일어났다고.
turns.reading: …myeot sin-de beol-sseo jeon-hwa-go. na bang-geum il-eo-nat-da-go.
turns.en: …What time is it that you're calling already. I just woke up, I said.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 거짓말 마라. 목소리부터 잠 덜 깬 티 난다 아이가.
turns.reading: geo-jit-mal ma-ra. mok-so-ri-bu-teo jam deol kkaen ti nan-da a-i-ga.
turns.en: Don't lie. Your voice alone shows you're still half asleep.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 아 몰라, 십 분만 더 잘게.
turns.reading: a mol-la, sip bun-man deo jal-ge.
turns.en: Ugh, I don't know, I'll sleep ten more minutes.

dialogues.question: 선우가 승객에게 전화한 이유는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: Why did Sunwoo call the passenger?
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 아직 자고 있는 승객을 놀리듯 깨우기 위해 아침 일찍 전화를 걸었습니다.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.en: See, you came out. Good morning, kid.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 너는 맨날 왜 이렇게 일찍 움직이는데?
turns.reading: neo-neun maen-nal wae i-reo-ke il-jjik um-jik-i-neun-de?
turns.en: Why do you always move around so early every day?

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 비행 있는 날은 새벽부터 일어나야 되거든. 몸에 뱄다, 이제.
turns.reading: bi-haeng it-neun nal-eun sae-byeok-bu-teo il-eo-na-ya doe-geo-deun. mom-e baet-da, i-je.
turns.en: On days I have a flight, I have to get up before dawn. It's become a habit by now.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 부지런한 척은. 그래도 오늘 아침 공기는 좋네.
turns.reading: bu-ji-reon-han cheok-eun. geu-rae-do o-neul a-chim gong-gi-neun jo-ne.
turns.en: Such a hard worker, huh. Still, the morning air is nice today.

dialogues.question: 선우가 아침 일찍 일어나는 습관이 생긴 이유는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: Why did Sunwoo develop the habit of waking up early in the morning?
dialogues.correct_answer: 비행 일정 때문에 새벽부터 일어나야 해서
options: 비행 일정 때문에 새벽부터 일어나야 해서
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 비행이 있는 날마다 새벽부터 일어나야 해서 이른 기상이 습관처럼 몸에 뱄다고 말합니다.
